summary: A roundtable recorded right after the August 2018 Unite the Right 2 rally in Washington, DC, where a few dozen white nationalists faced thousands of counter-protesters, debating whether physically confronting Nazis works and how police shielded them.

evidence.note: Goebbels in Weimar Berlin brought in as a comparison for street fighting, not covered years
long discussion of police guarding the marchers and turning into the opposing force
examples of US police agencies siding with far-right activists against anti-fascists
far-right chat logs from early 2018 about being outnumbered by protesters
evening standoff in DC over a Kekistan flag with police lines around two marchers
Kessler's post-rally tweets read and discussed, including his white civil rights framing
confronting a man filming a vulnerable protester to discredit the counter-protest
argument that white people shaming racists works better than punching them

notes: Protest report recorded the day of the rally, so current-affairs. fascism-far-right over nazism: the rally was a white nationalist event the hosts call Nazis; the Weimar segment is a comparison. Guest names are from the transcript: Hannah (Kitchen Table Cult) surname garbled; Lauren Mario spelling uncertain; Bridget identified as Bridget Todd from general knowledge (DC organizer). Robert is jokingly called Matt.
